relevance_rank_note: Isogenic human iPSC astrocytes (endogenous APOE4 vs APOE3): whole-cell label-free proteome, Table S1 lists of proteins lower or higher in APOE4, names only. Rows cover the ARF6 GAP ACAP3, recycling machinery (EHD2, EHD3, RAB11FIP5) and receptors or transporters (ABCA1, VLDLR). ARF6 itself is not listed. Total protein, not recycling; weakest evidence class in the set.

description: ACAP3, a GTPase-activating protein that switches ARF6 off, is listed among the proteins lower in isogenic APOE4 than APOE3 human iPSC astrocytes. ARF6 itself is not listed in any column (not changed or not detected; the table cannot say which). Less ACAP3 would be expected to leave more ARF6 active, but ARF6 activity was not measured. Table S1 lists names only (254 down, 238 up overall), with no fold change, P value, replicate number or cutoff. Total protein, so it does not show whether surface level or recycling changed.
quote: We found that 254 proteins were downregulated and 238 proteins were upregulated in ApoE4 astrocytes compared with those in ApoE3 astrocytes.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, isogenic human iPSC astrocytes) -> (lower total ACAP3, an ARF6 GAP; ARF6 not listed)
system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE4 vs APOE3 (endogenous APOE, gene-edited pairs). The paper uses three pairs: Coriell AG10788 (sporadic AD donor, female, 87, APOE4 parental, edited to APOE3), AG09173 (healthy donor, female, 75, APOE3 parental, edited to APOE4) and KOLF2.1J with its APOE4 line; which pair the proteomics used is not stated. Untreated cultures; label-free whole-cell proteomics. Total protein level, not surface level or recycling; replicate number not stated.
location: Table S1, 'Down in ApoE4 vs. ApoE3' column (ACAP3)
human_check: Read 2026-11-21 from the Elsevier CDN supplement PDFs (cell.com and ScienceDirect bot checks not clicked). Column assignment checked on the rendered Table S1 page images, because the PDF text layout shifts on later pages. Table S1 gives protein names only: no fold change, P value, replicate number or stated cutoff, so effect is qualitative and P and n are N/A. Added by team leader decision 2026-11-21 against the recommendation to leave the paper out.
